description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the OEM Suzuki Samurai JL/JA Model, Driver’s and Passenger’s Front Seats.
You will get everything you need to upgrade your seats to new.
This is NOT COVERS but rather the whole seat.
All you will need to do is to remove your existing seats and install the seat slides onto these seats and reinstall in to your Samurai.
These seats are OEM so everything will fit perfectly; no drilling, no cutting, no cussing, just bolts right up.
The seats color pattern is designed to reflect the suns heat giving you a cooler seat in the summer, especially when the tops off.
These seats are made from heavy, durable pressed vinyl and have an off-white patterned seating area and a dark gray side and back.
These will fit in both JL and JX models.
If you need seat slides we have them. Just look under “Interior Parts” in the column to the far left
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Drivers Seat Cushion
Qty 1 – Drivers Seat Back
Qty 1 – Drivers Seat Headrest
Qty 1 – Drivers Seat Recline Mechanism
Qty 1 – Drivers Seat Recline Mechanism Cover
Qty 1 – Passengers Seat Cushion
Qty 1 – Passengers Seat Back
Qty 1 – Passengers Seat Headrest
Qty 1 – Passengers Seat Recline Mechanism
Qty 1 – Passengers Seat Recline Mechanism Cover
Qty 1 – Assembly Bolt Package (does both seats)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1980 – 1984 All Models
